basic_info.description: Meaningful price reduction - put this at the top of your list! Welcome to this spacious full-floor condominium located in the heart of vibrant Lower Nob Hill-one of San Francisco's most walkable and architecturally rich neighborhoods. This elegant 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home spans 1,556 square feet and blends classic Edwardian character with thoughtful modern updates.  Occupying the entire middle floor of a boutique 3-unit building, this residence features newly refinished hardwood floors, soaring ceilings, and abundant natural light throughout. Two decorative fireplaces add warmth and historic charm to the generously sized living and dining rooms, while the renovated kitchen and baths offer sleek, contemporary style and convenience.  The flexible floor plan offers three bedrooms, with bay windows and ample closet space. A beautifully updated full bath and half bath, and a separate laundry area with hook ups, ensure comfort and functionality. Additional highlights include a large private storage room, shared yard, low HOA dues, and leased parking merely moments away. You're perfectly positioned to enjoy the best of San Francisco, a few short blocks from Polk Street, Nob Hill, Union Square, the Theater District, and a world-class dining scene. This is quintessential city living.
